# AstryxSpinner { #anylumino.AstryxSpinner }

```python
AstryxSpinner(label='Loading', **props)
```

Render an Astryx loading spinner.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | Default     |
|---------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| label   | str    | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                                                                                                                                             | `'Loading'` |
| **props | Any    | JSON-safe Spinner props. Useful keys: size, shade, label, aria-label, className, and style. size supports sm, md, and lg; shade supports default, onMedia, subtle, and inherit. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Spinner>. | `{}`        |
